description:
Advances: ancora.review

Severity: High (calibrated). Consolidated findings F7, F33, F34, F59, F60, F61. Found by driving two real generated artifacts in headless Chromium, not by reading templates.

F7 (the High) — Prism destroys the diff markup at load. lib/ancora/review/html.ex:270-278 emits per-line spans classed add/del/hunk_header, then :346 calls Prism.highlightAll(), which reads textContent and reassigns innerHTML, wiping every authored span (295,052 Prism token spans in the branch artifact, ZERO surviving .add). Prism diff grammar then splits each line into a one-character prefix span plus a line span, and .diff span{display:block} at :354 makes both block-level, so every diff line renders as TWO rows: a lone plus or minus, then the code beneath it, with all add/delete colouring gone. Separately prism.css is concatenated after css() in render/1:14 and its pre[class*=language-] selector outranks .diff, so the authored dark panel never applies (measured computed background rgb(245,242,240), black text) and dark-mode readers get a bright light block on a #171613 page. No string-level test can catch this: the file on disk is correct and the damage happens in the browser.
Fix: drop class="language-diff" from diff/1 <code> or exclude .diff from highlightAll(); tighten .diff span{display:block} to .diff > code > span; emit prism_css() BEFORE css(). Add one DOM-level assertion that pre.diff .add still exists after scripts run.

F33 — watched_card/1 at :199-202 hardcodes class="badge error", so an :acknowledged badge renders in error red (confirmed on the artifact), contradicting the "drift or acknowledged badge" requirement. Derive the class from card.badge.
F34 — per-finding severity is colour-only: finding/1 at :283-293 turns the severity atom into a CSS class and never into text, and .error/.warning/.info differ only in colour. The Introduced panel is 39 chips of which 20+ read change/uncovered_file with nothing to tell them apart until each details block is expanded, and finding.file is already in the view model but never rendered. Put the severity word and the file into the summary and add a non-colour marker. Contrast itself measured fine (4.78:1 and 4.97:1 light, 9.38:1 dark), so this is colour-as-sole-carrier, not contrast.
F59 — drop role="tablist" (the smaller honest change) or complete the contract with role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, role=tabpanel.
F60 — render generated_at in the overview and put the head ref into the <title>; the data is already in the view model.
F61 — add code{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.

Sibling: the 8x diff duplication and its duplicate-id knock-on are ancora-gqb, which also needs a contract line to exist first.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged tests under ancora.review in test/ancora/review_test.exs and test/ancora/review_assets_test.exs; one browser-level check that pre.diff .add survives script execution, run through playwright-cli (the playwright-browse skill) against a generated artifact and recorded in the IMPLEMENTED comment, since ExUnit cannot execute Prism
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) diff blocks are excluded from Prism.highlightAll (drop class=language-diff or scope the call) and the authored add/del spans survive in a real browser; (2) .diff span{display:block} is tightened to .diff > code > span; (3) prism_css() is emitted before css() so the authored dark panel wins; (4) watched_card badge class derives from card.badge; (5) each finding summary carries the severity word, the file, and a non-colour marker; (6) role=tablist is dropped or the tab contract is completed; (7) generated_at is rendered and the head ref is in <title>; (8) code{overflow-wrap:anywhere} is present; each of (1)-(3) and (5)-(8) also has a string-level guard test so a regression fails in CI
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or explicitly named test files, plus mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission plus tagged and --stale selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path.
  - Fixture hygiene: one TmpGitRepo per test, no shared temp dirs, async only where the fixture allows.
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface. Drift, growth, and shrink clear only through substantive requirement or scenario edits in the same diff, never through a Spec-Ack trailer.
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test.
- proves: a generated artifact keeps its add/del colouring in a browser, badges reflect card.badge, and severity is readable without colour.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/review/html.ex, lib/ancora/review.ex (view-model fields already computed; no scoping change), lib/ancora/markdown.ex
- test/ancora/review_test.exs, test/ancora/review_assets_test.exs, test/ancora/static/review_budget_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only: substantive requirement/scenario updates that clear drift/growth/shrink for this ticket's own changes; never weakening a must)

Out of Scope (files):
- priv/spec_review_assets/** (ancora-xla.8 pins and upgrades them)
- lib/ancora/review/spec_diff.ex, lib/ancora/review/findings_delta.ex (ancora-xla.6 deletes)
- lib/ancora/derive/**
- lib/ancora/gate*

Out of Scope (intent):
- no change to which files or subjects appear in the artifact (ancora-gqb)
- no extractor swap (ancora-xla.9 F17)
- no print stylesheet (dropped by the review)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission ends result=pass
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: Fix the review artifact rendering defects
